title: 2 miles to Downtown-Fast Wifi and Free Parking
description:
This condo is 1 bed/1 bath, 2nd floor (no elevator). This furnished condo has a large living room, a well-stocked kitchen so you can make a quick meal or a sit-down dinner and a separate bedroom w/ ensuite.

There are TVs in main living area and the bedroom.  Towels, cooking and bathroom essentials are provided.
Free onsite parking and high speed wi-fi is also included. Location provides easy access to Nashville attractions and events. Two miles from downtown.

The space
The main living area has the living room couch, TV, work desk, dining table and kitchen .  The bedroom is just off the living space.  Access to bathroom is directly from the bedroom.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire condo.  Free parking behind the building.

Other things to note
Lockbox code will be provided after booking.
